headline: Anthropic engineer challenges coding interviews as AI reshapes hiring
summary: An Anthropic engineer has publicly questioned the viability of traditional coding interviews, reflecting broader industry shifts as AI capabilities reshape technical assessment. This statement arrives amid Anthropic's expansion as a major enterprise AI provider and its own high-profile security breach. For healthcare AI specifically, this signals accelerating changes in how health IT vendors recruit talent for clinical AI development and EHR integration work. Healthcare organizations evaluating AI vendor maturity should monitor whether partners are adapting hiring practices to source engineers who can build more reliable clinical decision support systems. The talent pipeline and engineering culture at AI vendors directly impacts the robustness of AI tools deployed in healthcare workflows.
